title: Binding to a real object supplies this

ground_truth.statement: Binding to a real object supplies this. Binding a closure that does not access this to null is also valid. A nullable receiver must not be assumed always present.

notes: Clean-room semantic contract derived from the catalog lead, not a copy of its test harness. Runtime controls distinguish successful values from rejected or absent alternatives. This is a behavior comparison, not a recommendation that every precision limitation is product policy. Initial runtime used $this ?? null, which PHP rejects on a null-bound closure. The corrected fixture uses isset($this) before reading it; both binding controls now test the stated nullable behavior. Pinned-tool observations retained without widening expectations: psalm: InvalidScope@6, MixedReturnStatement@6; mago: redundant-condition@6. Runtime controls pass. These are measured precision or contract-interpretation disagreements, not assertions that the tool should adopt every tested policy.
